coffin.songTitle: Land: Horses / Land of a Thousand Dances / La Mer(de)
coffin.line: Johnny's laying there in his sperm coffin
stanza: Johnny's laying there in his sperm coffin
Angel looks down at him and says, "Oh, pretty boy can't you show me nothing but…
And Johnny gets up, takes off his leather jacket
Taped to his chest there's the answer
You got pen knives and jack knives and switchblades preferred
Then he cries, then he screams, saying
"Life is full of pain, I'm cruisin' through my brain"
And I fill my nose with snow and go Rimbaud
Go Rimbaud, go Rimbaud and go, Johnny, go
And do the Watusi, oh do the Watusi
